fia_question: Do the cast case wall and bay mounts survive motor reaction ~125 N·m and carrier output ~1002 N·m inside the 343×259×267 mm / 32 kg box as a SCREENING check?

geometry_provenance.controlling_dimensions: state.fpkConcentricGeometry housing OD/length with orchestratorContract bay / mass / power / rpm fallbacks
geometry_provenance.statement: Kit-sized analytical flange + bay-mount + thin-wall torsion screen from twin housing / bay / duty; not the CalculiX smoke cantilever and not a supplier cast mesh.

margins.note: SCREENING only against assumed ISO 898-1 class 8.8 bolt allowables and 180 MPa cast-Al yield. Equal-share bolt shear, thin-wall Bredt torsion, 5 g mass tension. Not supplier cast FEA, not fastener FEA, not fatigue. Never claim release FoS.

material_assumptions.label: Assumed M8 class 8.8 fasteners + A356-T6-class cast aluminium screening allowables — not supplier melt / heat-treat / fastener certificates.

model_assumptions: Motor reaction torque = continuous electrical power / (η=0.9777 × ω) — same seed as iso6336_fia_front_kit_case (~125 N·m).
Carrier output torque = motor torque × gear_ratio (default 8 → ~1000 N·m).
6 flange bolts on a circle at 90% of housing OD; equal-share tangential shear from motor reaction.
4 bay mounts on a pitch circle at 55% of min(bay_w, bay_d); equal-share tangential shear from carrier output.
Bay-mount tension from mass_aspiration × 5 g / 4 mounts (not a homologated crash pulse).
Housing wall torsion: thin closed cylinder τ = T / (2π r² t) with assumed t = 8 mm cast Al.
No ribbing, boss local stress, thread strip, preload, or fatigue.
Full cast-case CalculiX remains OPEN (mesh of whole housing deferred).

release_fos.statement: Screening FoS vs assumed bolt / cast-Al allowables is informational. Release factor of safety requires supplier cast FEA, fastener drawings, preload procedure, and correlated loads — not closed here.

release_statement: Concept evidence only. No FIA homologation, team interface closure, race evidence or permission to ship. Never claim PASS or closed release FoS from this screening case.

calculix_full_case.reason: Full cast-case / mount CalculiX mesh is deferred — too heavy for the screening self-test path; analytical bolt + wall screens are the PARTIAL evidence here.
